synopsis: OpenMATERIAL addresses the physical properties of the scene on the other side of the sensor-model interface [f4854]. However, the corpus found no measurement campaign in an OpenMATERIAL-type format covering rock, wet clay, gravel, steel or high-visibility fabric at lidar wavelengths and radar bands [f4383]. This is a gap in the available material evidence, not a claim that OpenMATERIAL lacks the relevant scope [f4383, f4854]. Because of that gap, the validation programme would have to create the required material layer itself [f4385].

relations.note: Identifies missing job-site material measurements within the scene-properties scope.
Creating the material layer is required because no suitable measurement campaign was found.
